head_commit.message:
Attribute compaction analytics to the correct voice session (#51963)

## Why

Compaction analytics lack a voice session ID. A compaction event can arrive after its voice session has closed or another session has started, so attribution needs to account for when compaction began.

## What changed

Add `voice_session_id` to compaction events. Track realtime session starts, ID updates, and closures, retaining up to 16 recent closed session windows. Resolve the session from the compaction start timestamp, falling back to the turn's voice session ID.

Forward realtime session ID updates from the app server to analytics and update the active turn's attribution.

## Testing

Add coverage for realtime session boundary facts, compaction event serialization, and delayed compaction events across consecutive voice sessions.

head_commit.message:
Support model-specific function description prefixes (#51930)

## What changed

Add `functions_namespace_functions_description_prefixes` to model tool messages, keyed by unqualified tool name. Prepend this guidance to descriptions in the `functions` namespace across direct declarations, Code Mode documentation, and tool-search results, including custom tools.

Trim prefixes, ignore empty values and unavailable functions, and enforce a combined 256-byte UTF-8 limit including separators for reachable tools. Keep overrides local to each step, preserve search ranking text, and retain runtime caches for unaffected tools.

## Testing

Extend coverage for direct and indirect descriptions, clearing prefixes when switching models, namespace scoping for deferred dynamic tools, and tool-search cache reuse and reset.

Support model-specific function description prefixes (#51930)

Add `functions_namespace_functions_description_prefixes` to model tool messages, keyed by unqualified tool name. Prepend this guidance to descriptions in the `functions` namespace across direct declarations, Code Mode documentation, and tool-search results, including custom tools.
